**Do not edit this file.** As in the data collection repository, the 0.75x scale, link masses
(body 0.78 kg + 4 x 0.005 kg rotors = 0.8 kg), rotor joint locking and zeroed initial velocities are
applied by the asset config (`assets/drones.py`), not stored in the USD.

## Original structure

- defaultPrim `/vehicle` (articulation root, self collision on), Z up, metres.
- `/vehicle/body`: rigid body, 1.5 kg with a stored `diagonalInertia` (0.029125, 0.029125, 0.055225)
  kg·m² from the PX4 Gazebo Iris. This must be cleared when the mass is overridden so the inertia is
  recomputed from the shape. The collider is one body+arms mesh (convex decomposition).
- `/vehicle/rotor0..3`: propeller rigid bodies (no mass set), `rotorN/jointN` revolute about z.
- Narrowest waist width at x = 0 is about 105 mm at full scale, about 79 mm at 0.75x. The gripper
  opens 107 mm, so the drone must be scaled.
